integrity: Finite exhaustive exact-arithmetic code verifies independent facet enumerations, 336 graph automorphisms, ten orbit representatives and level distributions. It does not constitute an independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the real Lipschitz-free unit ball of the Heawood unit-edge graph metric; ten orbits use graph automorphisms and global sign, not all potential polytope automorphisms. Does not calculate arbitrary projective-plane cases or complete face vectors. Bibliographic overlap with unindexed work cannot be excluded.
title: Ten facet-symmetry orbits of the Heawood Lipschitz-free ball
